designDecisions: COMPOSE, DO NOT REINVENT: build pe-record-cell-interpret.ts (a verbatim port of interpretParcelRecordCell, adapted to read the already-fetched /record response's per-rail {cell, companions} instead of issuing its own SQL) and pe-record-to-facets.ts (nine composer functions, ported field-for-field from the LDT reference adapters), so byte parity with what cortex already serves for these rails is a property of copying the same logic, not a coincidence of independently re-deriving it.

SCOPE CUT 1 -- zoning/envelope/setbacks stay atom-chain-owned. The dispatch's architecture section already states 'zoning and envelope from the retrieval atom chain' as the CURRENT, correct, R-2-protected design; P-153/DRAW and P-154/MOST-CURRENT separately own that surface. Composing these from /record would duplicate a working, ruled path and risk conflicting with R-2's polygon-drawn/figure-refused mechanism this lane has no mandate to touch.

SCOPE CUT 2 -- cadRoll (marketValue/assessedValue/landValue/improvementValue) and ownerFact stay cortex-sourced. Both rails ARE slated 'record' in the reader for the probe counties, but serving them from /record directly would bypass the Studio/Team/Property-Unlock entitlement gate entirely (the reader has no session concept at all) -- an explicit dispatch prohibition ('the entitlement gate is not yours to change'). Building a correct cross-service entitlement check within this lane's own scope was judged higher-risk than the value of moving these four rails' SOURCE this pass; the dispatch's own item 3 second half (fix the null-collapse-on-refusal bug) is completed instead, which is real, valuable, and does not touch the gate.

SCOPE CUT 3 -- apn/situsAddress/situsCity/situsState/landUse stay on the existing path. P-151/SEAM already shipped this wave re-seeding situs placement from the record's own point, and P-172/FIND BOX is active on the same address/situs family this same wave (per the dispatch's own warning). landUse was already flagged 'may remain on cortex temporarily' in this file's own pre-existing module doc, predating this lane.

Target rail set for this pass: cityLimits, flood, specialDistricts, wells, schoolDistrict, utilityService, overlayDistricts, agValuation, maxImperviousCoverPct (all nine have PE wire types already declared in atom-chain-to-facets.ts and an existing *FactFromParcelRecord.ts reference in LDT), plus baseFacts.acreage (acreageAcres/acreageSqft/acreageMethod, composed together only when all resolve) and livingAreaSqft/yearBuilt (present-only override -- absent/refused states on these two scalar fields are left to the existing structuralFact/verdict-layer path rather than inventing a LayerAbsenceWire-shaped absence this lane has no source data to construct correctly).

readPath becomes 'record' whenever the /record fetch succeeds, applied as a final override step AFTER the existing atom-chain+cortex-merge composition -- record wins per-field for any rail it slates 'record'; every other field is untouched. A failed /record fetch is a no-op (existing payload unchanged, readPath unchanged) -- never a crash, never a silent fallback dressed as success.

Fix the cadRoll null-collapse bug in the same pass: widen CadRollValueWire/isCadRollValueWire to admit cortex's existing {state:'refused', code:'studio-gated'} shape and pass it through mergeBakedBaseFacts's cadRollField helper, which currently drops any non-present/zero/absent shape to null. The client (fact-sheet-resolver.ts's cadRollFieldState/taxValuationFromCadRoll) already has a kind==='refused' branch that renders the correct upgrade cue -- confirmed by reading the client code before writing the fix, not assumed.
